page.layout: One printed page. Left margin holds marginal notes (catchwords of references) beside the verse. Main text in the centre: running verse, headings "Oppida Thessaliae", "Phthia", "Phyllos", "Larissa", "Iolchos", an ornamental woodcut band, the heading "GRÆCIA THESSALIAM", and a subtitle, then a decorated initial paragraph at the foot. Running head at top centre with page number at top left.

main_text.p:
Ephesus. Corinthus. Thebæ. Delphos. Palin. Leone.Aut Ephesum, bimarisve Corinthi
Moenia, vel Baccho Thebas, vel Apolline Delphos
Insignes, aut Thessala Tempe.
Est locus Aetherei prarupto in vertice montis,
Delicijs plenus, quo non felicior alter
Creditur esse vsquam, cui cedunt Thessala Tempe,
Elysiique lares, & fortunata vireta.
main_text.head: Oppida Thessaliæ.
Phthia.
main_text.p:
Seneca Troas.An viros tellus dare militares
Aptior Phthiæ?

Luc. lib. 6. Idem lib. 7.Atque olim Larissa potens
